segments.an2.52:1.1: “Dveme, bhikkhave, puggalā loke uppajjamānā uppajjanti bahujanahitāya bahujanasukhāya, bahuno janassa atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānaṃ.
segments.an2.52:1.3: Tathāgato ca arahaṃ sammāsambuddho, rājā ca cakkavattī.
segments.an2.52:1.4: Ime kho, bhikkhave, dve puggalā loke uppajjamānā uppajjanti bahujanahitāya bahujanasukhāya, bahuno janassa atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānan”ti.
segments.an2.53:1.1: “Dveme, bhikkhave, puggalā loke uppajjamānā uppajjanti acchariyamanussā.
segments.an2.53:1.3: Tathāgato ca arahaṃ sammāsambuddho, rājā ca cakkavattī.
segments.an2.53:1.4: Ime kho, bhikkhave, dve puggalā loke uppajjamānā uppajjanti acchariyamanussā”ti.
segments.an2.54:1.1: “Dvinnaṃ, bhikkhave, puggalānaṃ kālakiriyā bahuno janassa anutappā hoti.
segments.an2.54:1.3: Tathāgatassa ca arahato sammāsambuddhassa, rañño ca cakkavattissa.
segments.an2.54:1.4: Imesaṃ kho, bhikkhave, dvinnaṃ puggalānaṃ kālakiriyā bahuno janassa anutappā hotī”ti.
segments.an2.55:1.3: Tathāgato ca arahaṃ sammāsambuddho, rājā ca cakkavattī.
segments.an2.56:1.3: Tathāgato ca arahaṃ sammāsambuddho, paccekabuddho ca.
segments.an2.57:1.4: Ime kho, bhikkhave, dve asaniyā phalantiyā na santasantī”ti.
segments.an2.58:1.4: Ime kho, bhikkhave, dve asaniyā phalantiyā na santasantī”ti.
segments.an2.59:1.3: Bhikkhu ca khīṇāsavo, sīho ca migarājā.
segments.an2.59:1.4: Ime kho, bhikkhave, dve asaniyā phalantiyā na santasantī”ti.
segments.an2.60:1.1: “Dveme, bhikkhave, atthavase sampassamānā kiṃpurisā mānusiṃ vācaṃ na bhāsanti.
segments.an2.60:1.3: Mā ca musā bhaṇimhā, mā ca paraṃ abhūtena abbhācikkhimhāti.
segments.an2.60:1.4: Ime kho, bhikkhave, dve atthavase sampassamānā kiṃpurisā mānusiṃ vācaṃ na bhāsantī”ti.
segments.an2.61:1.1: “Dvinnaṃ dhammānaṃ, bhikkhave, atitto appaṭivāno mātugāmo kālaṃ karoti.
segments.an2.61:1.4: Imesaṃ kho, bhikkhave, dvinnaṃ dhammānaṃ atitto appaṭivāno mātugāmo kālaṃ karotī”ti.
segments.an2.62:1.2: Taṃ suṇātha, sādhukaṃ manasi karotha; bhāsissāmī”ti.
segments.an2.62:1.3: “Evaṃ, bhante”ti kho te bhikkhū bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
segments.an2.62:2.1: “Kathañca, bhikkhave, asantasannivāso hoti, kathañca asanto sannivasanti?
segments.an2.62:2.2: Idha, bhikkhave, therassa bhikkhuno evaṃ hoti –
segments.an2.62:2.3: ‘theropi maṃ na vadeyya, majjhimopi maṃ na vadeyya, navopi maṃ na vadeyya;
segments.an2.62:2.4: therampāhaṃ na vadeyyaṃ, majjhimampāhaṃ na vadeyyaṃ, navampāhaṃ na vadeyyaṃ.
segments.an2.62:2.5: Thero cepi maṃ vadeyya ahitānukampī maṃ vadeyya no hitānukampī, noti naṃ vadeyyaṃ viheṭheyyaṃ [viheseyyaṃ (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.)] passampissa nappaṭikareyyaṃ.
segments.an2.62:2.6: Majjhimo cepi maṃ vadeyya … pe … navo cepi maṃ vadeyya ahitānukampī maṃ vadeyya no hitānukampī, noti naṃ vadeyyaṃ viheṭheyyaṃ passampissa nappaṭikareyyaṃ’.
segments.an2.62:2.7: Majjhimassapi bhikkhuno evaṃ hoti … pe … navassapi bhikkhuno evaṃ hoti –
segments.an2.62:2.8: ‘theropi maṃ na vadeyya, majjhimopi maṃ na vadeyya, navopi maṃ na vadeyya;
segments.an2.62:2.9: therampāhaṃ na vadeyyaṃ, majjhimampāhaṃ na vadeyyaṃ, navampāhaṃ na vadeyyaṃ.
segments.an2.62:2.10: Thero cepi maṃ vadeyya ahitānukampī maṃ vadeyya no hitānukampī noti naṃ vadeyyaṃ viheṭheyyaṃ passampissa nappaṭikareyyaṃ.
segments.an2.62:2.11: Majjhimo cepi maṃ vadeyya … pe … navo cepi maṃ vadeyya ahitānukampī maṃ vadeyya no hitānukampī, noti naṃ vadeyyaṃ viheṭheyyaṃ passampissa nappaṭikareyyaṃ’.
segments.an2.62:2.12: Evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, asantasannivāso hoti, evañca asanto sannivasanti.
segments.an2.62:3.1: “Kathañca, bhikkhave, santasannivāso hoti, kathañca santo sannivasanti?
segments.an2.62:3.2: Idha, bhikkhave, therassa bhikkhuno evaṃ hoti –
segments.an2.62:3.3: ‘theropi maṃ vadeyya, majjhimopi maṃ vadeyya, navopi maṃ vadeyya;
segments.an2.62:3.4: therampāhaṃ vadeyyaṃ, majjhimampāhaṃ vadeyyaṃ, navampāhaṃ vadeyyaṃ.
segments.an2.62:3.5: Thero cepi maṃ vadeyya hitānukampī maṃ vadeyya no ahitānukampī, sādhūti naṃ vadeyyaṃ na viheṭheyyaṃ passampissa paṭikareyyaṃ.
segments.an2.62:3.6: Majjhimo cepi maṃ vadeyya … pe … navo cepi maṃ vadeyya hitānukampī maṃ vadeyya no ahitānukampī, sādhūti naṃ vadeyyaṃ na naṃ viheṭheyyaṃ passampissa paṭikareyyaṃ’.
segments.an2.62:3.7: Majjhimassapi bhikkhuno evaṃ hoti … pe … navassapi bhikkhuno evaṃ hoti –
segments.an2.62:3.8: ‘theropi maṃ vadeyya, majjhimopi maṃ vadeyya, navopi maṃ vadeyya;
segments.an2.62:3.9: therampāhaṃ vadeyyaṃ, majjhimampāhaṃ vadeyyaṃ, navampāhaṃ vadeyyaṃ.
segments.an2.62:3.10: Thero cepi maṃ vadeyya hitānukampī maṃ vadeyya no ahitānukampī, sādhūti naṃ vadeyyaṃ na naṃ viheṭheyyaṃ passampissa paṭikareyyaṃ.
segments.an2.62:3.11: Majjhimo cepi maṃ vadeyya … pe … navo cepi maṃ vadeyya hitānukampī maṃ vadeyya no ahitānukampī, sādhūti naṃ vadeyyaṃ na naṃ viheṭheyyaṃ passampissa paṭikareyyaṃ’.
segments.an2.62:3.12: Evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, santasannivāso hoti, evañca santo sannivasantī”ti.
segments.an2.63:1.1: “Yasmiṃ, bhikkhave, adhikaraṇe ubhato vacīsaṃsāro diṭṭhipaḷāso cetaso āghāto appaccayo anabhiraddhi ajjhattaṃ avūpasantaṃ hoti, tasmetaṃ, bhikkhave, adhikaraṇe pāṭikaṅkhaṃ –
segments.an2.63:1.2: ‘dīghattāya kharattāya vāḷattāya saṃvattissati, bhikkhū ca na phāsuṃ [phāsu (ka.)] viharissanti’.
segments.an2.63:2.1: Yasmiñca kho, bhikkhave, adhikaraṇe ubhato vacīsaṃsāro diṭṭhipaḷāso cetaso āghāto appaccayo anabhiraddhi ajjhattaṃ suvūpasantaṃ hoti, tasmetaṃ, bhikkhave, adhikaraṇe pāṭikaṅkhaṃ –
segments.an2.63:2.2: ‘na dīghattāya kharattāya vāḷattāya saṃvattissati, bhikkhū ca phāsuṃ viharissantī’”ti.

lines: Tatiye bahuno janassa anutappā hotīti mahājanassa anutāpakārī hoti.
Tattha cakkavattino kālakiriyā ekacakkavāḷe devamanussānaṃ anutāpaṃ karoti, tathāgatassa kālakiriyā dasasu cakkavāḷasahassesu.
Cakkavattino hi cetiyaṃ paṭijaggitvā dve sampattiyo labhanti, buddhānaṃ cetiyaṃ paṭijaggitvā tissopi.
Pañcame buddhāti attano ānubhāvena cattāri saccāni buddhā.
Tattha khīṇāsavo attano sakkāyadiṭṭhiyā pahīnattā na bhāyati, hatthājānīyo sakkāyadiṭṭhiyā balavattāti.
Mānusiṃ vācaṃ na bhāsantīti manussakathaṃ na kathenti.
Dhammāsokassa kira ekaṃ kinnaraṃ ānetvā dassesuṃ.
Eko puriso “ahametaṃ kathāpessāmī”ti heṭṭhāpāsādaṃ otāretvā dve khāṇuke koṭṭetvā ukkhaliṃ āropesi.
Taṃ disvā kinnaro “kiṃ aññaṃ ekaṃ khāṇukaṃ koṭṭetuṃ na vaṭṭatī”ti ettakameva āha.
Puna aparabhāge dve kinnare ānetvā dassesuṃ.
Eko puriso “ahamete kathāpessāmī”ti te gahetvā antarāpaṇaṃ agamāsi.
Tattheko ambapakkañca macche ca addasa, eko kabiṭṭhaphalañca ambilikāphalañca.
Tattha purimo “mahāvisaṃ manussā khādanti, kathaṃ te kilāsino na hontī”ti āha.
Itaro “kathaṃ ime etaṃ nissāya kuṭṭhino na hontī”ti āha.
Evaṃ mānusiṃ vācaṃ kathetuṃ sakkontāpi dve atthe sampassamānā na kathentīti.
Na vadeyyāti ovādena vā anusāsaniyā vā na vadeyya, mā vadatūti attho.
Therampāhaṃ na vadeyyanti ahampi theraṃ bhikkhuṃ ovādānusāsanivasena na vadeyyaṃ.
Noti naṃ vadeyyanti “ahaṃ tava vacanaṃ na karissan”ti naṃ vadeyyaṃ.
Passampissa nappaṭikareyyanti passantopi jānantopi ahaṃ tassa vacanaṃ na kareyyaṃ.
Sukkapakkhe pana sādhūti naṃ vadeyyanti “sādhu bhaddakaṃ sukathitaṃ tayā”ti tassa kathaṃ abhinandanto naṃ vadeyyanti attho.
Dvādasame ubhato vacīsaṃsāroti dvīsupi pakkhesu aññamaññaṃ akkosanapaccakkosanavasena saṃsaramānā vācā vacīsaṃsāro.
Diṭṭhipaḷāsoti diṭṭhiṃ nissāya uppajjanako yugaggāhalakkhaṇo paḷāso diṭṭhipaḷāso nāma.
Ajjhattaṃ avūpasantaṃ hotīti sabbampetaṃ niyakajjhattasaṅkhāte attano citte ca saddhivihārikaantevāsikasaṅkhātāya attano parisāya ca avūpasantaṃ hoti.
Dutiyapaṇṇāsakassa paṭhame hitaggahaṇena mettā vuttā hoti, na karuṇā, anukampāgahaṇena pana karuṇāti cakkavattinā saddhiṃ gahitattā “lokānukampāyā”ti na vuttaṃ.
Dutiye bahuso loke na ciṇṇā na pavattā manussāti āciṇṇamanussā.
Kadācideva hi nesaṃ loke nibbatti abhūtapubbā bhūtāti abbhutamanussā.
Tatiye dasasu cakkavāḷasahassesu anutāpaṃ karoti tassa ekabuddhakhettabhāvato.
Catutthe thūpassa yuttāti dhātuyo pakkhipitvā thūpakaraṇassa yuttā.
Chaṭṭhe pahīnattā na bhāyatīti attasinehābhāvato na bhāyati.
Sakkāyadiṭṭhiggahaṇañcettha nidassanamattaṃ, attasinehassa paṭighassa tadekaṭṭhasammohassa ca vasena bhāyanaṃ hotīti tesampi pahīnattā na bhāyati, aññathā sotāpannādīnaṃ abhayena bhavitabbaṃ siyā.
Dasame yathāāraddhe kicce vattamāne antarā eva paṭigamanaṃ paṭivānaṃ, natthi etassa paṭivānanti appaṭivāno.
Yathā asappurisā saha vasantā aññamaññaṃ agāravena anādariyaṃ karonti, tappaṭikkhepena sappurisānaṃ sagāravappaṭipattidassanaparamidaṃ suttaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ.
Dvādasame dvīsupi pakkhesūti vivādāpannānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ dvīsupi pakkhesu.
Anabhirādhanavasenāti yassa uppajjati, tassa tadaññesañca atthassa anabhirādhanavasena.
Attano citte parisāya ca citteti ānetvā sambandho.
